versions.changelog: 审查修复：补 allowed-tools 声明(ima-mcp读取+python渲染+present_files) + 收窄 triggers(移除过宽单独'看板'/'知识图谱'触发，限定 ima 知识库语境)
去个人化：移除个人库ID与真实姓名，统一为占位符
首版发布：IMA 知识库可视化看板，拉取 ima 结构生成自含 HTML 看板

Initial release of kb-dashboard: generate a visual HTML dashboard for your ima knowledge base.

- Triggers on keywords like “知识库看板”, “知识库可视化”, “生成知识图谱”, and related phrases.
- Fetches folder structure and KPI metrics from ima (read-only, via ima-mcp).
- Produces a self-contained, theme-switchable HTML dashboard: collapsible folder tree, KPI gauges, bar/pie charts, and a folder-level knowledge graph.
- Supports single library or global (multi-library) dashboards; users can select the target library.
- Clear boundary: does not modify, create, or write to the knowledge base—only visualizes the current structure and status.
